member.name: T:Acontplus.Services.Configuration.ApplicationConfigurationBuilder
member.summary: Builds the merged for every AcontPlus service.
member.remarks:
Priority order (lowest → highest, last wins):
appsettings.json
appsettings.{Environment}.json
Environment variables – for operational overrides and path resolution
Shared settings file – sharedsettings.{Environment}.json from the platform shared folder
Azure Key Vault – secrets only; activated when KeyVault:VaultUri or the KEYVAULT_URI environment variable is set
Local development: leave KeyVault:VaultUri unset and use User Secrets / sharedsettings.Development.json for sensitive values. When you do want to test against the dev vault, run az login first — will pick up those credentials automatically.
Azure-hosted environments (Staging / Production): set KeyVault:VaultUri in appsettings.json (or as the KEYVAULT_URI environment variable) and assign the Managed Identity the Key Vault Secrets User role on the vault. For user-assigned Managed Identities, also set KeyVault:ManagedIdentityClientId.
Key Vault secret naming convention: use double-dash as the hierarchy separator, e.g. JwtSettings--SecurityKey, ConnectionStrings--DefaultConnection, AwsConfiguration--AWSSecretKey.

member.name: M:Acontplus.Services.Configuration.ApplicationConfigurationBuilder.Load
member.summary: Builds the merged hierarchy including JSON settings, environment variables, shared platform settings, and Azure Key Vault.
member.returns: The built instance.
